kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتزعزع (form IIq)
# نَتَزَعْزَعُ (natazaʕzaʕu) /na.ta.zaʕ.za.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَزَعْزَعَ (tazaʕzaʕa)
# نَتَزَعْزَعَ (natazaʕzaʕa) /na.ta.zaʕ.za.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَزَعْزَعَ (tazaʕzaʕa)
# نَتَزَعْزَعْ (natazaʕzaʕ) /na.ta.zaʕ.zaʕ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَزَعْزَعَ (tazaʕzaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
